recipe.visualDefinition: A studio-lit composition featuring three distinct poses of the same blonde female subject in a vibrant red jumpsuit, arranged horizontally against a pale blue-grey background. The layout uses a rhythmic repetition of the figure to suggest movement, topped with large, fluid script lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant red clothing against a muted cool-toned background
Repetition of the subject to create a narrative sequence
Large-scale script typography framing the central figure
High-key studio lighting with soft shadows
coreInvariants: Monochromatic red wardrobe (sheer top, tight leggings, boots)
Triple repetition of the primary subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-body figures distributed across the horizontal plane, scaled to fill the vertical space from mid-thigh to head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure facing forward acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from left to right, following the progression of poses from expressive to poised to interacting with a secondary figure on the far right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space at the top for large display typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Red (wardrobe) creates high visual energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale Blue-Grey (background) provides a clean, cool contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Black (typography and secondary figure) provides grounding weight.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject vs. low saturation in the background.

letterConstructionRules: Large, sweeping loops on capital letters
Connected lowercase letters with high legibility
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated descenders and ascenders that frame the subject's head

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Two main words separated by central figure

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid, large-scale script paired with small, rigid, angled sans-serif for dynamic contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century to 70s casual script energy.
Provides the necessary rigid contrast for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a blonde woman in three different poses (left: surprised/singing, center: confident/smiling, right: leaning against a man in a suit). She wears a monochromatic bright red outfit consisting of a sheer blouse, leggings, and high-heeled boots. The background is a flat, pale blue-grey. Lighting is soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, black, monolinear script lettering across the top, split into two main words. Intersperse smaller, uppercase, bold sans-serif words at a 30-degree angle between the script elements.

verificationChecks: Is the red outfit vibrant and consistent across all three figures?
Is the script lettering fluid and monolinear?
Is the background a clean, muted blue-grey?
Are the secondary text elements angled correctly?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the three figures feel like part of the same scene.
Check that the script does not obscure the faces.
Verify the red color is not 'blown out' or losing detail.
Confirm the secondary text is legible despite the angle.
recipe.reuseFormula: Triple-subject repetition + high-saturation monochromatic wardrobe + pale cool background + large-scale monolinear script overlay.
